<!doctype html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>EHC Uzwil Hawks · Sponsorenlauf</title>
<style>
:root{--navy:#10233f;--blue:#174d83;--gold:#f0b323;--bg:#f3f6fa;--ink:#17263b;--muted:#68778c;--line:#e2e8f0;--white:#fff;--green:#16794b}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.45 Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
header{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#10233f,#174d83);color:#fff;padding:27px max(20px,calc((100vw - 1220px)/2));border-bottom:5px solid var(--gold)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px}.brand-logo{width:76px;height:76px;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;padding:3px;flex:none;box-shadow:0 2px 12px #07182a55}.mark{display:none;width:47px;height:47px;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:50%;place-items:center;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold);font-size:13px}header{position:relative}
.header-logout{position:absolute;top:22px;right:max(20px,calc((100vw - 1220px)/2));padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid #f0b323;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#10233f;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}
.header-logout:hover{background:#f0b323}
.header-logout[hidden]{display:none!important}
.brand h1{font-size:24px;line-height:1.15;margin:0}.brand p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#d5e3f4}
main{max-width:1220px;margin:24px auto;padding:0 18px}.panel{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #16365a0a}
.panel h2{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 12px}.upload-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:end}.field label{display:block;font-weight:650;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}.field input,.field select{width:100%;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;background:white;color:var(--ink)}input[type=file]{font-size:13px}
button{border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--blue);color:white;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}button:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}button.secondary{background:#e9eff6;color:var(--navy)}button.gold{background:var(--gold);color:#14253c}.hint,.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.hint{margin:11px 0 0}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:end;flex-wrap:wrap}.toolbar .field{min-width:165px}.toolbar .push{margin-left:auto}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:13px;margin-bottom:18px}.stat{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:16px 17px}.stat .label{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.stat strong{display:block;font-size:24px;margin-top:5px;letter-spacing:-.4px}.stat small{color:var(--muted)}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:18px}.chart-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr 95px;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:10px 0;font-size:13px}.track{height:10px;background:#edf1f6;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden}.bar{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#174d83,#f0b323);border-radius:20px}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:790px}th,td{padding:10px 11px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}th{background:#f6f8fb;color:#4b5c72;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.035em;position:sticky;top:0}th button{padding:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left;font-size:inherit;font-weight:750}td.num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}tbody tr:hover{background:#f8fbff}.rank{font-weight:800;color:var(--blue)}.name{font-weight:700}.tag{font-size:11px;background:#edf3fa;color:#31577f;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:99px}
.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}.empty{padding:28px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
footer{max-width:1220px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px 28px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
#modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#07182ab8;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;z-index:10}#modal.open{display:flex}.modal-box{max-width:760px;width:100%;max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;background:white;border-radius:14px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 18px 65px #0004}.modal-box h2{margin:0 0 7px}.cluster{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin:12px 0}.cluster h3{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 9px}.member-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr minmax(180px,260px);gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:7px 0}.member-row input{padding:8px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:7px}.modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.dashboard-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.dashboard-tab{appearance:none;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 18px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0}
.dashboard-tab:hover{background:#eaf0f7;color:var(--navy)}
.dashboard-tab:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f0b323;outline-offset:2px}
.dashboard-tab.is-active{color:var(--blue);border-bottom-color:var(--gold);background:#fff}
.dashboard-tabpanel[hidden]{display:none!important}
.import-save-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.import-save-actions button{min-width:190px}
 .import-save-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.import-save-actions button{min-height:40px}
#viewStatus[data-tone="success"],#uploadStatus[data-tone="success"]{color:#16794b}
#viewStatus[data-tone="error"],#uploadStatus[data-tone="error"]{color:#a52a2a}
#protectedDashboard[hidden],#viewGate[hidden]{display:none!important}

.year-compare-legend{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.year-compare-legend span{display:inline-flex;gap:7px;align-items:center}
.year-compare-legend i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block}
.legend-solo{background:#174d83}.legend-family{background:#f0b323}
.year-compare-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(100px,1fr) 120px;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin:12px 0}
.year-compare-year{font-weight:750;color:var(--navy)}
.year-compare-track{height:16px;background:#edf1f6;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;display:flex}
.year-compare-solo{height:100%;background:#174d83}
.year-compare-family{height:100%;background:#f0b323}
.year-compare-total{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:620px){.year-compare-row{grid-template-columns:48px minmax(60px,1fr) 92px;gap:7px;font-size:13px}}
@media(max-width:780px){.upload-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.toolbar .push{margin-left:0}.brand h1{font-size:20px}}
</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
</head>
<body>
<header><div class="brand"><img class="brand-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="EHC Uzwil Hawks Logo"><div><h1>EHC Uzwil Hawks</h1><p>Sponsorenlauf · Auswertung &amp; Rangliste</p></div><button id="headerLogoutBtn" class="header-logout" type="button" hidden>Abmelden</button></div></header>
<main>
<nav class="dashboard-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Bereiche">
<button class="dashboard-tab is-active" id="tabButtonOverview" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="tabOverview" tabindex="0">Übersicht</button>
<button class="dashboard-tab" id="tabButtonComparison" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tabComparison" tabindex="-1" hidden>Jahresvergleich</button>
<button class="dashboard-tab" id="tabButtonImport" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tabImport" tabindex="-1" hidden>Import &amp; Speichern</button>
</nav>
<section id="tabOverview" class="dashboard-tabpanel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tabButtonOverview">
<section id="viewGate" class="panel">
<div class="section-head"><h2>Auswertung geschützt</h2><span class="tag">Passwort erforderlich</span></div>
<p class="hint">Melde dich mit deinem in Supabase freigeschalteten Admin- oder Viewer-Konto an, um die Sponsorenlaufdaten abzurufen.</p>
<div class="toolbar">
<div class="field" style="min-width:260px"><label for="viewEmail">Supabase-E-Mail</label><input id="viewEmail" type="email" autocomplete="username" placeholder="Deine Supabase-E-Mail"></div>
<div class="field" style="min-width:260px"><label for="viewPassword">Passwort</label><input id="viewPassword" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="Supabase-Auth-Passwort"></div>
<button class="gold" id="unlockDashboardBtn" type="button">Daten anzeigen</button>
</div>
<p id="viewStatus" class="hint" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</section>
<div id="protectedDashboard" hidden>
<section class="panel">
<div class="toolbar">
<div class="field"><label for="yearFilter">Jahr</label><select id="yearFilter"></select></div>
<div class="field"><label for="runnerFilter">Ansicht</label><select id="runnerFilter"><option value="combined">Einzelpersonen + Familien</option><option value="individual">Nur Einzelpersonen</option><option value="family">Nur Familien</option></select></div>
<div class="field"><label for="teamFilter">Team</label><select id="teamFilter"><option value="">Alle Teams</option></select></div>
<div class="field"><label for="totalFilter">Gesamt</label><select id="totalFilter"><option value="all">Alle Beträge</option><option value="zero">Gesamt = 0</option><option value="positive">Gesamt &gt; 0</option></select></div>
<div class="field"><label for="search">Suche</label><input id="search" type="search" placeholder="Name oder Team"></div>
<button class="secondary" id="csvBtn">Rangliste exportieren (CSV)</button><button class="secondary" id="lockDashboardBtn" type="button">Abmelden / Ansicht sperren</button>
</div>
</section>
<div class="cards" id="stats"></div><div id="unassignedCashNotice" class="panel" style="display:none;padding:12px 16px;border-left:4px solid var(--gold)"></div>
<div class="split">
<section class="panel"><div class="section-head"><h2>Sammlung nach Team</h2><span class="muted">Brutto · CHF</span></div><div id="teamChart"></div></section>
<section class="panel"><div class="section-head"><h2>Abrechnung</h2><span class="tag">Fundoo 7%</span></div><div id="feeBreakdown"></div></section>
</div>
<section class="panel">
<div class="section-head"><h2 id="rankTitle">Top 50 Sammler</h2><span class="muted" id="rankCount"></span></div>
<div class="table-wrap" id="tableHost"></div>
</section>
</div>
</section>
<section id="tabComparison" class="dashboard-tabpanel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tabButtonComparison" hidden>
 <section class="panel">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>Jahresvergleich</h2><span class="tag">Supabase-Jahresdaten</span></div>
 </section>
 <div class="cards" id="yearCompareStats"></div>
 <section class="panel">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>Gesamtsammlung je Jahr</h2><span class="muted">Einzelpersonen + Familien · CHF</span></div>
  <div class="year-compare-legend"><span><i class="legend-solo"></i> Einzelpersonen</span><span><i class="legend-family"></i> Familien</span></div>
  <div id="yearCompareChart"></div>
 </section>
 <section class="panel">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>Teilnehmende und Familien im Vergleich</h2><span class="muted">Beträge in CHF</span></div>
  <div class="table-wrap" id="yearCompareTable"></div>
 </section>
 <section class="panel">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>Einzelne Läufer</h2><span class="muted">Alle Jahre · Beträge in CHF</span></div>
  <div class="table-wrap" id="yearCompareRunnersTable"></div>
 </section>
</section>
<section id="tabImport" class="dashboard-tabpanel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tabButtonImport" hidden>
<section class="panel">
<h2>Daten hochladen</h2>
<div class="upload-grid">
<div class="field"><label for="exportFile">1. Teilnehmer-Export (.xlsx)</label><input id="exportFile" type="file" accept=".xlsx,.csv"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="roundFile">2. Teilnehmer Runden (.xlsx)</label><input id="roundFile" type="file" accept=".xlsx,.csv"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="yearInput">Jahr</label><input id="yearInput" type="number" min="2000" max="2100" value="2026"></div>
<button class="gold" id="importBtn">Importieren</button>
</div>
<p class="hint">Die zwei Dateien werden anhand der Teilnehmer-ID zusammengeführt. Cash, Runden, Pauschalbeitrag und Beitrag pro Runde werden den jeweiligen Spalten entnommen. Nur angemeldete Admins können Excel-Daten importieren. Der Import wird als ausstehender Upload in Supabase gespeichert und kann anschliessend von einem Admin freigegeben werden.</p>
</section>
<section class="panel" id="pendingUploadsPanel">
<div class="section-head"><h2>Ausstehende Uploads</h2><span class="tag">Freigabe erforderlich</span></div>
<p class="hint">Die Excel-Daten werden erst beim Import nach Supabase übertragen. Uploads bleiben zunächst ausstehend und ändern die aktive Rangliste erst nach Admin-Freigabe.</p>
<div id="pendingUploadsList" class="empty">Melde dich zuerst im Reiter «Übersicht» mit dem Anzeige-Passwort an.</div>
</section>
<p id="uploadStatus" class="hint" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</section>
</main>
<footer>Berechnung: Cash + Pauschal + (Runden × Beitrag pro Runde). Fundoo-Gebühr: 7% auf Pauschal- und Rundenbeiträge, nicht auf Cash. Rundungsdarstellung auf 2 Dezimalstellen.</footer>
<div id="modal"><div class="modal-box"><h2>Familienzugehörigkeit klären</h2><p class="muted">Wähle pro Läufer einen Familiennamen aus, um Personen derselben Familie zusammenzufassen. Wähle <b>Einzel</b>, wenn die Person keiner Familie zugeordnet werden soll. Der eigene Nachname ist vorausgewählt.</p><div id="clusters"></div><div class="modal-actions"><button id="confirmFamilies">Zugehörigkeiten übernehmen</button></div></div></div>
<script>
const SUPABASE_URL='https://whnjxemobjoluluhkmyd.supabase.co';
const SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY='sb_publishable_wLtdx28jAqSNTkUdpvixfA_ErWOnWE2';
const EVENT_KEY='ehc-uzwil-hawks';
const money=new Intl.NumberFormat('de-CH',{style:'currency',currency:'CHF',maximumFractionDigits:2});
let years={};
let supabaseClient=null;
let currentUser=null;
let currentRole='';
let familyQueue=[];
function norm(s){return String(s??'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('de-CH')}
function amount(x){let n=Number(x);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0}
function calc(p){p.roundValue=amount(p.rounds)*amount(p.unit);p.gross=amount(p.cash)+amount(p.flat)+p.roundValue;p.fee=(amount(p.flat)+p.roundValue)*.07;p.net=p.gross-p.fee;return p}
function activeYear(){return document.getElementById('yearFilter').value}
function dataset(){return (years[activeYear()]||[]).map(p=>calc({...p}))}
function currency(x){return money.format(amount(x))}
function sortedTeams(data){let a={};data.forEach(p=>{let t=p.group||'Ohne Team';a[t]=(a[t]||0)+p.gross});return Object.entries(a).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1])}
function renderYearOptions(preferred){let s=document.getElementById('yearFilter'),old=s.value;let ys=Object.keys(years).sort((a,b)=>b-a);s.innerHTML=ys.length?ys.map(y=>`<option value="${y}">${y}</option>`).join(''):'<option value="">Noch keine Jahresdaten</option>';if(preferred&&ys.includes(String(preferred)))s.value=String(preferred);else if(ys.includes(old))s.value=old;render()}
function render(){
 let data=dataset(),teamSel=document.getElementById('teamFilter'),old=teamSel.value,teams=[...new Set(data.map(p=>p.group||'Ohne Team'))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'de'));
 teamSel.innerHTML='<option value="">Alle Teams</option>'+teams.map(t=>`<option>${esc(t)}</option>`).join('');if(teams.includes(old))teamSel.value=old;
 let tm=teamSel.value,q=norm(document.getElementById('search').value),mode=document.getElementById('runnerFilter').value;
 let all=data, shown=all.filter(p=>(!tm||(p.group||'Ohne Team')===tm)&&(!q||norm(p.first+' '+p.last+' '+p.group).includes(q)));
 let rankable=shown.filter(p=>!p.unassignedCash);
 let totalMode=document.getElementById('totalFilter').value;
 let cash=all.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.cash,0),flat=all.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.flat,0),rv=all.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.roundValue,0),gross=cash+flat+rv,fee=(flat+rv)*.07,net=gross-fee;
 const unassignedCash=all.filter(p=>p.unassignedCash).reduce((sum,p)=>sum+amount(p.cash),0);
 const noticeEl=document.getElementById('unassignedCashNotice');
 if(noticeEl){noticeEl.style.display=unassignedCash>0?'block':'none';noticeEl.innerHTML=unassignedCash>0?`<b>Cash ohne Teilnehmer-ID:</b> ${currency(unassignedCash)} — im Gesamtbetrag enthalten, aber keiner Person zugeordnet und deshalb nicht in der Top-50-Rangliste.`:''}
 document.getElementById('stats').innerHTML=[
 ['Brutto-Sammlung',currency(gross),'Cash + Pauschal + Rundenbeiträge'],
 ['Cash-Beiträge',currency(cash),'Keine Fundoo-Gebühr'],
 ['Fundoo-Gebühr',currency(fee),'7% auf Pauschal + Runden'],
 ['Netto nach Gebühr',currency(net),'Brutto abzüglich Fundoo']
 ].map(x=>`<div class="stat"><span class="label">${x[0]}</span><strong>${x[1]}</strong><small>${x[2]}</small></div>`).join('');
 const teamData=sortedTeams(all),max=Math.max(1,...teamData.map(x=>x[1]));
 document.getElementById('teamChart').innerHTML=teamData.map(([t,v])=>`<div class="chart-row"><b>${esc(t)}</b><div class="track"><div class="bar" style="width:${v/max*100}%"></div></div><span>${currency(v)}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Keine Teamdaten</div>';
 document.getElementById('feeBreakdown').innerHTML=`<div class="chart-row"><b>Cash</b><div class="track"><div class="bar" style="width:${gross?cash/gross*100:0}%"></div></div><span>${currency(cash)}</span></div><div class="chart-row"><b>Pauschal</b><div class="track"><div class="bar" style="width:${gross?flat/gross*100:0}%"></div></div><span>${currency(flat)}</span></div><div class="chart-row"><b>Runden</b><div class="track"><div class="bar" style="width:${gross?rv/gross*100:0}%"></div></div><span>${currency(rv)}</span></div><hr style="border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:15px 0"><div class="chart-row"><b>Gebühr</b><div></div><b style="text-align:right">${currency(fee)}</b></div><div class="chart-row"><b>Netto</b><div></div><b style="text-align:right">${currency(net)}</b></div>`;
 let individualRows=rankable.map(p=>({...p,label:p.first+' '+p.last,people:1,roundCount:p.rounds,unit:p.unit,group:p.group,memberNames:p.first+' '+p.last}));
 let familyRows=makeFamilies(rankable);
 let rows=mode==='family'?familyRows:(mode==='combined'?combinedRanking(rankable,familyRows):individualRows);
 // Filter after building leaderboard entities, so family totals are tested as a whole.
 if(totalMode==='zero') rows=rows.filter(p=>Math.abs(p.gross)<0.005);
 if(totalMode==='positive') rows=rows.filter(p=>p.gross>=0.005);
 rows.sort((a,b)=>b.gross-a.gross);
 const totalRows=rows.length;
 rows=rows.slice(0,50);
 document.getElementById('rankTitle').textContent=mode==='family'?'Top 50 Familien':mode==='combined'?'Top 50 Einzelpersonen + Familien':'Top 50 Einzelpersonen';
 document.getElementById('rankCount').textContent=`${rows.length} von ${totalRows} angezeigt`;
 renderTable(rows,mode);
 renderYearComparison();
}
function makeFamilies(data){
 let groups={}; data.forEach(p=>{let key=(p.familyKey||'').trim();if(!key||norm(key)==='einzel')return;let k=norm(key);if(!groups[k])groups[k]={label:key,people:0,cash:0,flat:0,roundValue:0,roundCount:0,members:[],teams:new Set()};let g=groups[k];g.people++;g.cash+=p.cash;g.flat+=p.flat;g.roundValue+=p.roundValue;g.roundCount+=p.rounds;g.members.push(p.first+' '+p.last);g.teams.add(p.group||'Ohne Team')});
 return Object.values(groups).filter(g=>g.people>=2).map(g=>({...g,gross:g.cash+g.flat+g.roundValue,fee:(g.flat+g.roundValue)*.07,net:g.cash+g.flat+g.roundValue-(g.flat+g.roundValue)*.07,memberNames:g.members.join(', '),group:[...g.teams].join(', '),unit:null}));
}
function combinedRanking(data,familyRows){
 let familyKeys=new Set(familyRows.map(g=>norm(g.label)));
 let singles=data.filter(p=>!familyKeys.has(norm((p.familyKey||'').trim())) || !p.familyKey || norm(p.familyKey)==='einzel')
   .map(p=>({...p,label:p.first+' '+p.last,people:1,roundCount:p.rounds,unit:p.unit,group:p.group,memberNames:p.first+' '+p.last}));
 return [...familyRows,...singles];
}
let sortKey='gross',sortDir=-1;
function renderTable(rows,mode){
 const cols=[['rank','#'],['label',mode==='family'?'Familie':mode==='combined'?'Person / Familie':'Teilnehmer'],['group','Team(s)'],['people','Anzahl'],['cash','Cash'],['flat','Pauschal'],['roundCount','Runden'],['roundValue','Rundenbeitrag'],['gross','Brutto']];
 let data=[...rows];data.sort((a,b)=>{let x=a[sortKey],y=b[sortKey];if(typeof x==='string')return sortDir*x.localeCompare(y,'de');return sortDir*((x||0)-(y||0))});
 let host=document.getElementById('tableHost');
 if(!data.length){host.innerHTML='<div class="empty">'+(mode==='family'?'Keine bestätigten Familiengruppen mit mindestens zwei Teilnehmenden.':'Keine Teilnehmenden gefunden.')+'</div>';return}
 host.innerHTML=`<table><thead><tr>${cols.map(([k,l])=>`<th>${k==='rank'?l:`<button data-sort="${k}">${l} ${sortKey===k?(sortDir===-1?'↓':'↑'):''}</button>`}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${data.map((p,i)=>`<tr><td class="rank">${i+1}</td><td><span class="name">${esc(p.label)}</span>${p.people>1?` <span class="tag">${p.people} Personen</span>`:''}<div class="muted">${esc(p.memberNames||'')}</div></td><td>${esc(p.group||'—')}</td><td class="num">${p.people??1}</td><td class="num">${currency(p.cash)}</td><td class="num">${currency(p.flat)}</td><td class="num">${Number(p.roundCount||0).toLocaleString('de-CH')}</td><td class="num">${currency(p.roundValue)}</td><td class="num"><b>${currency(p.gross)}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
 host.querySelectorAll('[data-sort]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let k=b.dataset.sort;if(sortKey===k)sortDir*=-1;else{sortKey=k;sortDir=-1}render()});
}
function esc(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function askFamilies(data,onDone){
 if(!Array.isArray(data)){onDone();return}
 let counts={};
 data.forEach(p=>{let k=norm(p.last);if(k)counts[k]=(counts[k]||0)+1});
 familyQueue=data.filter(p=>(counts[norm(p.last)]||0)>1 && !String(p.familyKey||'').trim());
 if(!familyQueue.length){onDone();return}

 const familyNames=[...new Set(familyQueue.map(p=>String(p.last||'').trim()).filter(Boolean))]
  .sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'de'));
 const familyOptions=[...familyNames];
 familyQueue.forEach(p=>{
  const existing=String(p.familyKey||'').trim();
  if(existing && norm(existing)!=='einzel' && !familyOptions.some(x=>norm(x)===norm(existing)))familyOptions.push(existing);
 });
 const familyOptionHtml=familyOptions.map(name=>`<option value="${esc(name)}">${esc(name)}</option>`).join('');
 let clusterMap={};
 familyQueue.forEach(p=>{let k=p.last||'(ohne Nachname)';(clusterMap[k]??=[]).push(p)});
 let html='';
 Object.entries(clusterMap).forEach(([surname,ps])=>{
  html+=`<div class="cluster"><h3>${esc(surname)} · ${ps.length} Teilnehmende</h3>`+
   ps.map(p=>{
    const current=String(p.familyKey||'').trim();
    const defaultValue=current || surname;
    return `<div class="member-row"><span>${esc(p.first)} ${esc(p.last)} <span class="muted">(${esc(p.group)})</span></span><select data-id="${esc(p.id)}" aria-label="Familienzuordnung für ${esc(p.first)} ${esc(p.last)}">${familyOptionHtml}<option value="Einzel">Einzel</option></select></div>`;
   }).join('')+'</div>';
 });
 document.getElementById('clusters').innerHTML=html;
 [...document.querySelectorAll('#clusters select')].forEach(select=>{
  const person=familyQueue.find(p=>String(p.id)===select.dataset.id);
  const current=String(person?.familyKey||'').trim();
  const defaultValue=current || String(person?.last||'').trim();
  const matchingOption=[...select.options].find(o=>norm(o.value)===norm(defaultValue));
  select.value=matchingOption?matchingOption.value:'Einzel';
 });
 document.getElementById('confirmFamilies').onclick=()=>{
  let selects=[...document.querySelectorAll('#clusters select')];
  let byId=Object.fromEntries(selects.map(el=>[el.dataset.id,el.value]));
  data.forEach(p=>{if(byId[p.id]!==undefined)p.familyKey=byId[p.id]});
  document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('open');
  onDone();
 };
 document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('open');
}
function headers(row){if(!Array.isArray(row))throw Error('Importformat ungültig: Kopfzeile ist keine Tabellenzeile.');return row.map(x=>norm(x).replace(/[_\s]+/g,' '))}
function findCol(h,arr){return h.findIndex(x=>arr.includes(x))}
async function parseFile(file){
 if(file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')){let text=await file.text();return csvParse(text)}
 let buf=await file.arrayBuffer(),zip=await unzip(buf);
 let decoder=new TextDecoder(), ss=[];
 if(zip.has('xl/sharedStrings.xml')){let doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(decoder.decode(zip.get('xl/sharedStrings.xml')),'text/xml');ss=[...doc.getElementsByTagNameNS('*','si')].map(si=>[...si.getElementsByTagNameNS('*','t')].map(t=>t.textContent).join(''))}
 let sheetPath='xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml';
 if(zip.has('xl/workbook.xml')&&zip.has('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels')){
  let w=new DOMParser().parseFromString(decoder.decode(zip.get('xl/workbook.xml')),'text/xml'), rel=new DOMParser().parseFromString(decoder.decode(zip.get('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels')),'text/xml');
  let first=w.getElementsByTagNameNS('*','sheet')[0], rid=first?.getAttribute('r:id');
  let link=[...rel.getElementsByTagNameNS('*','Relationship')].find(x=>x.getAttribute('Id')===rid)?.getAttribute('Target');
  if(link)sheetPath=link.startsWith('/')?link.slice(1):'xl/'+link.replace(/^\.?\//,'');
 }
 if(!zip.has(sheetPath))throw Error('Kein Tabellenblatt in '+file.name+' gefunden.');
 let doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(decoder.decode(zip.get(sheetPath)),'text/xml');
 return [...doc.getElementsByTagNameNS('*','row')].map(row=>{let a=[];[...row.getElementsByTagNameNS('*','c')].forEach(c=>{let ref=c.getAttribute('r')||'', col=ref.replace(/[0-9]/g,'');let ix=0;for(let z of col)ix=ix*26+z.charCodeAt(0)-64;ix--;let t=c.getAttribute('t'),v=c.getElementsByTagNameNS('*','v')[0]?.textContent??'';if(t==='s')v=ss[Number(v)]||'';else if(t==='inlineStr')v=[...c.getElementsByTagNameNS('*','t')].map(x=>x.textContent).join('');else if(t!=='str'&&t!=='e')v=v===''?'':Number(v);a[ix]=v});return a})
}
async function unzip(buffer){
 const dv=new DataView(buffer),bytes=new Uint8Array(buffer);let eocd=-1;
 for(let i=bytes.length-22;i>=Math.max(0,bytes.length-65558);i--){if(dv.getUint32(i,true)===0x06054b50){eocd=i;break}}
 if(eocd<0)throw Error('Ungültige XLSX-Datei (ZIP-Ende fehlt).');
 const count=dv.getUint16(eocd+10,true),start=dv.getUint32(eocd+16,true),out=new Map();let pos=start;
 for(let n=0;n<count;n++){if(dv.getUint32(pos,true)!==0x02014b50)break;let method=dv.getUint16(pos+10,true),csize=dv.getUint32(pos+20,true),nl=dv.getUint16(pos+28,true),el=dv.getUint16(pos+30,true),cl=dv.getUint16(pos+32,true),off=dv.getUint32(pos+42,true),name=new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.slice(pos+46,pos+46+nl));let lp=off+30+dv.getUint16(off+26,true)+dv.getUint16(off+28,true);let raw=bytes.slice(lp,lp+csize);let data=method===0?raw:method===8?new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([raw]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate-raw'))).arrayBuffer()):null;if(!data)throw Error('Kompressionsformat nicht unterstützt: '+method);out.set(name,data);pos+=46+nl+el+cl}
 return out
}
function csvParse(text){let lines=text.replace(/^\uFEFF/,'').split(/\r?\n/).filter(x=>x.trim());return lines.map(line=>{let a=[],s='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<line.length;i++){let c=line[i];if(c==='"'&&line[i+1]==='"'&&q){s+='"';i++}else if(c==='"')q=!q;else if((c===','||c===';')&&!q){a.push(s);s=''}else s+=c}a.push(s);return a.map(v=>{let z=v.trim();return z!==''&&!isNaN(z)?Number(z):z})})}
function numberCell(v){if(typeof v==='number')return v;let s=String(v??'').trim().replace(/['’\s]/g,'').replace(',','.');let n=Number(s);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0}
function getCol(h, names){return findCol(h,names.map(norm).map(s=>s.replace(/[_\s]+/g,' ')))}
async function doImport(){
 if(!currentUser||currentRole!=='admin'){setUploadStatus('Importieren dürfen nur angemeldete Admins.','error');return}
 let f1=document.getElementById('exportFile').files[0],f2=document.getElementById('roundFile').files[0],year=document.getElementById('yearInput').value;
 if(!f1||!f2){alert('Bitte beide Dateien auswählen.');return}
 try{
  let a=await parseFile(f1),b=await parseFile(f2),h1=headers(a[0]),h2=headers(b[0]);
  let ix={id:getCol(h1,['ID']),first:getCol(h1,['Vorname']),last:getCol(h1,['Nachname']),flat:getCol(h1,['Spenden pauschal']),unit:getCol(h1,['Spenden pro Einheit']),group:getCol(h1,['Gruppen','Team'])};
  let ir={id:getCol(h2,['ID']),first:getCol(h2,['Vorname']),last:getCol(h2,['Nachname']),group:getCol(h2,['Gruppen','Team']),rounds:getCol(h2,['Runden','Leistung','Anzahl Runden','Rundenanzahl']),cash:getCol(h2,['Cash'])};
  if(ix.id<0||ix.first<0||ix.last<0||ix.flat<0||ix.unit<0||ir.id<0||ir.rounds<0||ir.cash<0){
   const missing=[];
   if(ix.id<0)missing.push('Teilnehmer-Export: ID');
   if(ix.first<0)missing.push('Teilnehmer-Export: Vorname');
   if(ix.last<0)missing.push('Teilnehmer-Export: Nachname');
   if(ix.flat<0)missing.push('Teilnehmer-Export: Spenden pauschal');
   if(ix.unit<0)missing.push('Teilnehmer-Export: Spenden pro Einheit');
   if(ir.id<0)missing.push('Runden-Datei: ID');
   if(ir.rounds<0)missing.push('Runden-Datei: Runden/Leistung');
   if(ir.cash<0)missing.push('Runden-Datei: Cash');
   throw Error('Erforderliche Spalten fehlen: '+missing.join(', ')+'.');
  }
  let exportRows=a.slice(1).filter(r=>r[ix.id]!=null&&String(r[ix.id]).trim()!=='');
  let exportIds=new Set(exportRows.map(r=>String(r[ix.id]).trim()));
  let rmap=new Map(b.slice(1).filter(r=>r[ir.id]!=null&&String(r[ir.id]).trim()!=='').map(r=>[String(r[ir.id]).trim(),r]));
  let out=exportRows.map(r=>{let pid=String(r[ix.id]).trim(),rr=rmap.get(pid)||[];return {id:pid,first:String(r[ix.first]||''),last:String(r[ix.last]||''),group:String((ix.group>=0&&r[ix.group])||(ir.group>=0&&rr[ir.group])||'Ohne Team'),flat:numberCell(r[ix.flat]),unit:numberCell(r[ix.unit]),rounds:numberCell(rr[ir.rounds]),cash:numberCell(rr[ir.cash]),familyKey:''}});
  let unmatchedCash=b.slice(1).filter(r=>{let rid=ir.id>=0?String(r[ir.id]??'').trim():'';return (!rid||!exportIds.has(rid))&&numberCell(r[ir.cash])!==0;}).reduce((sum,r)=>sum+numberCell(r[ir.cash]),0);
  if(Math.abs(unmatchedCash)>0.001)out.push({id:'__unassigned_cash__',first:'Nicht zugeordnet',last:'Cash ohne Teilnehmer-ID',group:'Ohne ID',flat:0,unit:0,rounds:0,cash:unmatchedCash,familyKey:'',unassignedCash:true});
  if(!out.length)throw Error('Keine Teilnehmenden gefunden.');
  askFamilies(out,async()=>{
   try{
    const client=getSupabaseClient();
    const {error}=await client.from('sponsor_year_submissions').insert({
      event_key:EVENT_KEY,year:Number(year),participants:out,status:'pending'
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    setUploadStatus(`Upload eingereicht: ${out.length} Datensätze für ${year}. Er erscheint nach Admin-Freigabe in der Auswertung.`,'success');
    if(currentUser)await loadCloudYears();
   }catch(e){
    document.getElementById('uploadStatus').textContent='Upload fehlgeschlagen: '+e.message;
    document.getElementById('uploadStatus').dataset.tone='error';
    alert('Upload fehlgeschlagen: '+e.message);
   }
  });
 }catch(e){alert('Import fehlgeschlagen: '+e.message)}
}
function exportCsv(){
 let data=dataset().map(calc).filter(p=>!p.unassignedCash),mode=document.getElementById('runnerFilter').value;
 let families=makeFamilies(data);
 let rows=mode==='family'?families:(mode==='combined'?combinedRanking(data,families):data.map(p=>({...p,label:p.first+' '+p.last,people:1,roundCount:p.rounds,memberNames:p.first+' '+p.last})));
 rows.sort((a,b)=>b.gross-a.gross);
 let header=['Rang','Name/Familie','Mitglieder','Team','Cash CHF','Pauschal CHF','Runden','Beitrag/Runde CHF','Rundenbeitrag CHF','Brutto CHF'];
 let csv=[header,...rows.map((p,i)=>[i+1,p.label,p.people||1,p.group,p.cash,p.flat,p.roundCount,p.unit??'',p.roundValue,p.gross])].map(r=>r.map(v=>'"'+String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(';')).join('\r\n');
 let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['\uFEFF'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}));a.download=`hawks-sponsorenlauf-${activeYear()}-${mode}.csv`;a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href)
}
function getSupabaseClient(){
 if(!window.supabase||typeof window.supabase.createClient!=='function')
  throw new Error('Supabase-Client konnte nicht geladen werden. Internetverbindung prüfen.');
 if(!supabaseClient)supabaseClient=window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL,SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY);
 return supabaseClient;
}
function setViewStatus(message,tone=''){
 const el=document.getElementById('viewStatus');
 el.textContent=message;
 if(tone)el.dataset.tone=tone;else delete el.dataset.tone;
}
function setUploadStatus(message,tone=''){
 const el=document.getElementById('uploadStatus');
 el.textContent=message;
 if(tone)el.dataset.tone=tone;else delete el.dataset.tone;
}

function renderYearComparison(){
 const statsHost=document.getElementById('yearCompareStats');
 const chartHost=document.getElementById('yearCompareChart');
 const tableHost=document.getElementById('yearCompareTable');
 const runnersHost=document.getElementById('yearCompareRunnersTable');
 if(!statsHost||!chartHost||!tableHost||!runnersHost)return;
 const yearList=Object.keys(years).sort((a,b)=>Number(a)-Number(b));
 const rows=yearList.map(year=>{
  const people=(Array.isArray(years[year])?years[year]:[])
   .filter(p=>!p.unassignedCash).map(p=>calc({...p}));
  const families=makeFamilies(people);
  const familyKeys=new Set(families.map(f=>norm(f.label)));
  const familyMembers=people.filter(p=>familyKeys.has(norm(p.familyKey)));
  const solo=people.filter(p=>!familyKeys.has(norm(p.familyKey)));
  const total=people.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+amount(p.gross),0);
  const familyTotal=families.reduce((sum,f)=>sum+amount(f.gross),0);
  const soloTotal=solo.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+amount(p.gross),0);
  return {year,total,participantCount:people.length,
   avgRunner:people.length?total/people.length:0,
   soloCount:solo.length,soloTotal,avgSolo:solo.length?soloTotal/solo.length:0,
   familyCount:families.length,familyMemberCount:familyMembers.length,
   familyTotal,avgFamily:families.length?familyTotal/families.length:0};
 });
 if(!rows.length){
  statsHost.innerHTML='<div class="panel empty">Nach der Anmeldung sind noch keine Jahresdaten in Supabase vorhanden.</div>';
  chartHost.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Keine Jahresdaten vorhanden.</div>';
  tableHost.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Keine Jahresdaten vorhanden.</div>';
  runnersHost.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Keine Läuferdaten vorhanden.</div>';
  return;
 }
 const latest=rows[rows.length-1],previous=rows.length>1?rows[rows.length-2]:null;
 const delta=(value,prior)=>{
  if(!previous||prior===undefined||prior===null||prior===0)return 'Kein Vorjahresvergleich';
  const pct=(value-prior)/Math.abs(prior)*100;
  return `${pct>=0?'+':''}${pct.toLocaleString('de-CH',{maximumFractionDigits:1})}% gegenüber ${previous.year}`;
 };
 statsHost.innerHTML=[
  {label:`Gesamtsammlung ${latest.year}`,value:currency(latest.total),delta:delta(latest.total,previous?.total)},
  {label:`Teilnehmende ${latest.year}`,value:String(latest.participantCount),delta:previous?`${latest.participantCount-previous.participantCount>=0?'+':''}${latest.participantCount-previous.participantCount} gegenüber ${previous.year}`:'Kein Vorjahresvergleich'},
  {label:'Durchschnitt pro Läufer',value:currency(latest.avgRunner),delta:delta(latest.avgRunner,previous?.avgRunner)},
  {label:'Durchschnitt pro Familie',value:latest.familyCount?currency(latest.avgFamily):'—',delta:latest.familyCount?delta(latest.avgFamily,previous?.avgFamily):'Keine Familiengruppen'}
 ].map(x=>`<div class="stat"><span class="label">${esc(x.label)}</span><strong>${esc(x.value)}</strong><small>${esc(x.delta)}</small></div>`).join('');
 const maxTotal=Math.max(1,...rows.map(r=>r.total));
 chartHost.innerHTML=rows.map(r=>{
  const soloWidth=Math.max(0,r.soloTotal/maxTotal*100);
  const familyWidth=Math.max(0,r.familyTotal/maxTotal*100);
  return `<div class="year-compare-row"><span class="year-compare-year">${esc(r.year)}</span>
   <div class="year-compare-track" role="img" aria-label="${esc(r.year)}: ${esc(currency(r.soloTotal))} Einzelpersonen, ${esc(currency(r.familyTotal))} Familien">
    <span class="year-compare-solo" style="width:${soloWidth}%"></span><span class="year-compare-family" style="width:${familyWidth}%"></span>
   </div><span class="year-compare-total">${esc(currency(r.total))}</span></div>`;
 }).join('');
 const cols=['Jahr','Gesamt','Teilnehmende','Ø pro Läufer','Einzelpersonen','Betrag Einzelpersonen','Ø pro Einzelperson','Familien','Familienmitglieder','Betrag Familien','Ø pro Familie'];
 tableHost.innerHTML=`<table><thead><tr>${cols.map(c=>`<th>${esc(c)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.slice().reverse().map(r=>`<tr>
  <td><b>${esc(r.year)}</b></td><td class="num"><b>${esc(currency(r.total))}</b></td>
  <td class="num">${r.participantCount}</td><td class="num">${esc(currency(r.avgRunner))}</td>
  <td class="num">${r.soloCount}</td><td class="num">${esc(currency(r.soloTotal))}</td>
  <td class="num">${r.soloCount?esc(currency(r.avgSolo)):'—'}</td><td class="num">${r.familyCount}</td>
  <td class="num">${r.familyMemberCount}</td><td class="num">${esc(currency(r.familyTotal))}</td>
  <td class="num">${r.familyCount?esc(currency(r.avgFamily)):'—'}</td>
 </tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;

 const runnerRows=[];
 for(const year of yearList){
  const people=(Array.isArray(years[year])?years[year]:[])
   .filter(p=>!p.unassignedCash)
   .map(p=>calc({...p}));
  const familyKeys=new Set(makeFamilies(people).map(f=>norm(f.label)));
  for(const person of people){
   const key=String(person.familyKey||'').trim();
   const isFamily=!!key&&norm(key)!=='einzel'&&familyKeys.has(norm(key));
   runnerRows.push({
    year,
    name:`${person.first||''} ${person.last||''}`.trim()||'—',
    group:person.group||'—',
    family:isFamily?key:'—',
    cash:amount(person.cash),
    flat:amount(person.flat),
    rounds:amount(person.rounds),
    unit:amount(person.unit),
    roundValue:amount(person.roundValue),
    gross:amount(person.gross)
   });
  }
 }
 runnerRows.sort((a,b)=>Number(b.year)-Number(a.year)||b.gross-a.gross||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'de'));
 const runnerCols=['Jahr','Läufer','Team','Familie','Cash','Pauschal','Runden','Beitrag/Runde','Rundenbeitrag','Total'];
 runnersHost.innerHTML=runnerRows.length
  ? `<table><thead><tr>${runnerCols.map(c=>`<th>${esc(c)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${runnerRows.map(r=>`<tr>
    <td><b>${esc(r.year)}</b></td><td class="name">${esc(r.name)}</td><td>${esc(r.group)}</td><td>${esc(r.family)}</td>
    <td class="num">${esc(currency(r.cash))}</td><td class="num">${esc(currency(r.flat))}</td>
    <td class="num">${r.rounds.toLocaleString('de-CH')}</td><td class="num">${esc(currency(r.unit))}</td>
    <td class="num">${esc(currency(r.roundValue))}</td><td class="num"><b>${esc(currency(r.gross))}</b></td>
   </tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`
  : '<div class="empty">Keine Läuferdaten vorhanden.</div>';
}

function configureRoleTabs(){
 const comparisonTab=document.getElementById('tabButtonComparison');
 const importTab=document.getElementById('tabButtonImport');
 const signedIn=!!currentUser&&(currentRole==='admin'||currentRole==='viewer');
 const canImport=signedIn&&currentRole==='admin';
 comparisonTab.hidden=!signedIn;
 comparisonTab.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!signedIn));
 importTab.hidden=!canImport;
 importTab.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!canImport));
 if(!signedIn)activateDashboardTab(0);
}
async function loadCloudYears(){
 if(!supabaseClient||!currentUser)throw new Error('Bitte zuerst anmelden.');
 const client=getSupabaseClient();
 const [{data:adminRow,error:adminError},{data:viewerRow,error:viewerError}]=await Promise.all([
  client.from('sponsor_admins').select('user_id').eq('user_id',currentUser.id).maybeSingle(),
  client.from('sponsor_viewers').select('user_id').eq('user_id',currentUser.id).maybeSingle()
 ]);
 if(adminError)throw adminError;
 if(viewerError)throw viewerError;
 if(!adminRow&&!viewerRow)throw new Error('Dieses Konto ist noch nicht für die Hawks-Auswertung freigeschaltet.');
 currentRole=adminRow?'admin':'viewer';
 configureRoleTabs();
 const {data,error}=await client.from('sponsor_years')
   .select('year,participants').eq('event_key',EVENT_KEY).order('year',{ascending:false});
 if(error)throw error;
 years={};
 for(const row of (data||[])){
  const list=Array.isArray(row.participants)?row.participants:[];
  years[String(row.year)]=list.map(p=>({...p,
   first:p.first??'',last:p.last??'',group:p.group??'',
   flat:Number(p.flat??0),unit:Number(p.unit??0),rounds:Number(p.rounds??0),
   cash:Number(p.cash??0),familyKey:p.familyKey??''
  }));
 }
 if(currentRole==='admin'){
  const {data:pending,error:pendingError}=await client.from('sponsor_year_submissions')
    .select('id,year,submitted_at,participants')
    .eq('event_key',EVENT_KEY).eq('status','pending')
    .order('submitted_at',{ascending:false}).limit(50);
  if(pendingError)throw pendingError;
  renderPendingUploads((pending||[]).map(x=>({
   id:x.id,year:x.year,submitted_at:x.submitted_at,
   participant_count:Array.isArray(x.participants)?x.participants.length:0
  })));
  document.getElementById('pendingUploadsPanel').hidden=false;
 }else{
  renderPendingUploads([]);
  document.getElementById('pendingUploadsPanel').hidden=true;
 }
 document.getElementById('viewGate').hidden=true;
 document.getElementById('protectedDashboard').hidden=false;
 renderYearOptions();
 setViewStatus(`${currentRole==='admin'?'Admin':'Nur-Lese-Zugang'}: ${currentUser.email}. ${Object.keys(years).length} Jahr/Jahre aus Supabase geladen.`,'success');
}
async function saveYearToSupabase(year){
 if(!supabaseClient||!currentUser||currentRole!=='admin')throw new Error('Nur ein Hawks-Admin darf Jahresdaten speichern.');
 const y=Number(year),list=years[String(year)];
 if(!Number.isInteger(y)||y<2000||y>2100||!Array.isArray(list))throw new Error('Jahr oder Teilnehmendenliste ungültig.');
 const {error}=await getSupabaseClient().from('sponsor_years').upsert({
  event_key:EVENT_KEY,year:y,participants:list,updated_by:currentUser.id,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()
 },{onConflict:'event_key,year'});
 if(error)throw error;
}
async function approveSubmission(item,button){
 if(currentRole!=='admin'){setViewStatus('Nur Admins dürfen Uploads freigeben.','error');return}
 button.disabled=true;
 try{
  const client=getSupabaseClient();
  const {data:submission,error:readError}=await client.from('sponsor_year_submissions')
    .select('id,event_key,year,participants,status').eq('id',item.id).single();
  if(readError)throw readError;
  if(!submission||submission.status!=='pending')throw new Error('Upload wurde bereits bearbeitet.');
  years[String(submission.year)]=(submission.participants||[]).map(p=>({...p}));
  await saveYearToSupabase(submission.year);
  const {error:updateError}=await client.from('sponsor_year_submissions')
    .update({status:'approved',reviewed_at:new Date().toISOString(),approved_by:currentUser.id})
    .eq('id',submission.id).eq('status','pending');
  if(updateError)throw updateError;
  await loadCloudYears();
  document.getElementById('yearFilter').value=String(submission.year);
  render();
  setViewStatus(`Upload für ${submission.year} freigegeben und angezeigt.`,'success');
 }catch(e){
  button.disabled=false;
  setViewStatus('Freigabe fehlgeschlagen: '+e.message,'error');
 }
}
function renderPendingUploads(pending){
 const host=document.getElementById('pendingUploadsList');
 host.replaceChildren();
 if(!pending?.length){host.textContent='Keine offenen Uploads.';return}
 for(const item of pending){
  const card=document.createElement('div');card.className='cluster';
  const title=document.createElement('h3');title.textContent=`Jahr ${item.year} · ${item.participant_count} Datensätze`;
  const date=document.createElement('p');date.className='muted';
  date.textContent=`Eingereicht: ${new Date(item.submitted_at).toLocaleString('de-CH')}`;
  const button=document.createElement('button');button.className='gold';button.type='button';
  button.textContent='Als Jahresdaten freigeben';
  button.onclick=()=>approveSubmission(item,button);
  card.append(title,date,button);host.append(card);
 }
}
async function unlockDashboard(email,password,askFamiliesAfter=true){
 try{
  const mail=String(email||'').trim(),pass=String(password||'');
  if(!mail||!pass)throw new Error('Bitte Admin-E-Mail und Passwort eingeben.');
  setViewStatus('Anmeldung bei Supabase…');
  const client=getSupabaseClient();
  const {data,error}=await client.auth.signInWithPassword({email:mail,password:pass});
  if(error)throw error;
  currentUser=data.user;
  await loadCloudYears();
  document.getElementById('headerLogoutBtn').hidden=false;
  const year=activeYear();
  if(currentRole==='admin'&&askFamiliesAfter&&year&&years[year]){
   askFamilies(years[year],async()=>{
    try{await saveYearToSupabase(year);render();setViewStatus(`Jahr ${year} und Familienzuordnungen gespeichert.`,'success')}
    catch(e){setViewStatus('Familienzuordnungen konnten nicht gespeichert werden: '+e.message,'error')}
   });
  }
 }catch(e){
  currentUser=null;currentRole='';
  configureRoleTabs();
  document.getElementById('headerLogoutBtn').hidden=true;
  document.getElementById('protectedDashboard').hidden=true;
  document.getElementById('viewGate').hidden=false;
  setViewStatus('Anmeldung fehlgeschlagen: '+e.message,'error');
 }
}
async function lockDashboard(){
 try{if(supabaseClient)await supabaseClient.auth.signOut()}catch(_){}
 currentUser=null;currentRole='';years={};
 configureRoleTabs();
 document.getElementById('headerLogoutBtn').hidden=true;
 document.getElementById('viewPassword').value='';
 document.getElementById('viewEmail').value='';
 document.getElementById('protectedDashboard').hidden=true;
 document.getElementById('viewGate').hidden=false;
 document.getElementById('pendingUploadsList').textContent='Melde dich zuerst im Reiter «Übersicht» als Admin an.';
 renderYearOptions();
 setViewStatus('Abgemeldet. Die Auswertung ist gesperrt.');
}
const dashboardTabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')];
function activateDashboardTab(index,focus=false){
 if(!dashboardTabs[index]||dashboardTabs[index].hidden)index=0;
 dashboardTabs.forEach((tab,i)=>{
  const active=i===index;
  tab.classList.toggle('is-active',active);
  tab.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(active));
  tab.tabIndex=active?0:-1;
  const panel=document.getElementById(tab.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
  if(panel)panel.hidden=!active;
 });
 if(focus)dashboardTabs[index].focus();
}
dashboardTabs.forEach((tab,index)=>{
 tab.addEventListener('click',()=>activateDashboardTab(index));
 tab.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
  if(!['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Home','End'].includes(event.key))return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const visibleTabs=dashboardTabs.map((tab,i)=>({tab,i})).filter(x=>!x.tab.hidden);
  let position=visibleTabs.findIndex(x=>x.i===index);
  if(position<0)return;
  if(event.key==='ArrowRight')position=(position+1)%visibleTabs.length;
  if(event.key==='ArrowLeft')position=(position-1+visibleTabs.length)%visibleTabs.length;
  if(event.key==='Home')position=0;
  if(event.key==='End')position=visibleTabs.length-1;
  activateDashboardTab(visibleTabs[position].i,true);
 });
});
document.getElementById('unlockDashboardBtn').onclick=()=>unlockDashboard(
 document.getElementById('viewEmail').value,
 document.getElementById('viewPassword').value
);
document.getElementById('viewPassword').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')unlockDashboard(document.getElementById('viewEmail').value,e.currentTarget.value)});
document.getElementById('lockDashboardBtn').onclick=lockDashboard;
document.getElementById('headerLogoutBtn').onclick=lockDashboard;
document.getElementById('importBtn').onclick=()=>{if(currentUser&&currentRole==='admin')doImport();else setUploadStatus('Importieren dürfen nur angemeldete Admins.','error')};
document.getElementById('csvBtn').onclick=exportCsv;
['runnerFilter','teamFilter','totalFilter'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).onchange=render);
document.getElementById('yearFilter').onchange=()=>{
 render();
 const year=activeYear();
 if(currentUser&&currentRole==='admin'&&year&&years[year]){
  askFamilies(years[year],async()=>{try{await saveYearToSupabase(year);render();setViewStatus(`Familienzuordnungen für ${year} gespeichert.`,'success')}catch(e){setViewStatus('Familienzuordnungen konnten nicht gespeichert werden: '+e.message,'error')}});
 }
};
document.getElementById('search').oninput=render;
renderYearOptions();
</script>
</body></html>
